sources.description: The Baltimore Ravens will be counting on their young outside linebacker depth to step up after Tavius Robinson’s season-ending pectoral injury. The fourth-year defender occupied a 72% defensive snap share to start the season (46.6 per game) while also contributing to the kick return, punt return, and field goal block teams.
